dict.Cerere de restituire a garanției de bună: Request to return the performance retention
dict.Cererea firmei către client, la sfârșitu: The company's request to the customer, at the end of the warranty period of the works, for the money withheld from invoices as a performance retention: the contract, the acceptances, the table of amounts withheld per invoice, the amount to return, the account to pay into and the attached documents
dict.Data eliberării se socotește aici de la: The release date is counted here from the acceptance on completion of the works plus the warranty months; the contract may also require the final acceptance, or a bank guarantee letter instead of the retention.
dict.Garanția de bună execuție e partea din f: The performance retention is the part of each invoice the customer keeps until the end of the warranty period of the works; the company withholds it the same way from its subcontractors' invoices.
dict.Luni de garanție, când nu sunt scrise pe: Warranty months, when not written on the row
dict.Partea din facturi reținută ca garanție: The part of invoices withheld as a performance retention, by customers or by the company from subcontractors: from the invoiced value and the percentage you get the retention, the release date (acceptance plus warranty months), what is left and the status: returned (green), in progress or under warranty (blue), released within 30 days (yellow), to claim back or to return (red).
dict.Procentul reținut, când nu e scris pe râ: Retention percentage, when not written on the row
dict.Procentul și durata sunt cele din contra: The percentage and the duration are those in the contract: write them on each row; the ones under “Rules” are used only when the row is empty.
